Cucumber Rounds
By: Anonymous
Published: Thursday, February 11, 2010 - 10:35pm

Ingredients




1 pound Cucumber
1 pkt Cream cheese, softened 8 oz
teaspoon Mayonnaise
teaspoon Seasoned salt
1 loaf multi grain bread
Parsley sprigs

Preparation

1 Cut cucumber in half horizontally. Peel, seed and shred half of cucumber. 2 Measure 1/3 cup shredded cucumber. Slice remaining cucumber for garnish. 3 Cut slices in half; set aside. Combine cream cheese, mayonnaise and seasoned salt, mixing until blended. Stir in shredded cucumber. Cut two 2 inch rounds from each bread slice. Spread each round with 1 teaspoon cucumber spread. Garnish each sandwich with a thin slice of cucumber and a sprig of parsley. 4 Makes 48 sandwiches.
